items.headline: AA Decision Index v2: decision models top out at 73; Haiku 5.5 Max 77
items.why: Drex Max and GLiDE tie at 73, Mammoth 72. Language models score higher but cost far more per task (Luna Max 76).

items.headline: Sapiens AI's Agnes 2.5 Pro Theta scores 24 on AA Intelligence Index
items.why: Proprietary, 1M context, $0.10/$0.30 per 1M tokens. Released Nov 7; no lab launch post found.

items.headline: FT: Anthropic bought ~$3.4B of gas generators, about 1.7 GW, from OnePWR
items.why: Commitments from late September per FT. Anthropic and OnePWR did not comment.

items.headline: xAI: Grok API text watermarking on by default from Sat 7 Nov
items.why: Covers grok-4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3/4.20 plus tool-call arguments. Team admins can opt out per model.

items.headline: xAI turns on default Grok API text watermarking
items.why: Listed grok-4.x models from Nov 7. Admins can opt out per model; check the x-watermark header.

items.headline: Meta rolls Wonder-trained models into Muse and Meta AI
items.why: Meta's own eval: Active Memory 90% vs 76% on using critical context. Muse Spaces shipped the same day.

items.headline: Nous drops Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B
items.why: Post-trained to cut propaganda-style answers (lab: 22% to about 1%). No AA Index score yet.

items.headline: OpenAI partners with Hacktron and widens its Daybreak Red access
items.why: Joint testing of how OpenAI systems touch third-party services, alongside higher bug bounties.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly closes ~$11B tranche at ~$1.25T valuation
items.why: Bloomberg via TechCrunch. Full round may reach about $20B. OpenAI had not commented.

items.headline: Anthropic publishes agent-memory research on notes and dreaming
items.why: How agents keep notes in session and consolidate memory offline, with Managed Agents case studies.

items.headline: Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Small; AA Index 31; Apache 2.0 weights next week
items.why: 594B MoE / 17B active, 1M context; Tinker now with closed weights. AA: would lead non-China open-weights once weights land.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for approved Daybreak Red security customers
items.why: OpenAI reports ExploitGym 48.5% vs 32.1%, a Critical cyber class, 81 novel Firefox highs, and 948 Linux exploits.

items.headline: AA now labels Kimi K3.1 Pro as open-weights; Index still 46
items.why: Live AA page says open weights and links Hugging Face. It leads AA's open-source comparison. No Index rescore.

items.headline: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash GA: 15-second video, 30% cheaper
items.why: Price is $0.07/sec at 720p, with multi-turn edits. API and Cloud GA. Outputs carry a SynthID watermark.

items.headline: Anthropic rolls out Claude Personal Finance beta in the US
items.why: Read-only Plaid bank links on Pro, Max, and Ultra. Cannot move or invest money. Hub chats are not used for training.

items.headline: Mistral Studio adds Managed Agents, apps, and workflow builder
items.why: Public preview dated 5 Nov. Python Agents SDK can run locally, self-hosted, or on Mistral, including durable background jobs.

items.headline: Perplexity launches Teammates, persistent agents for ongoing work
items.why: Always-on work agents. The Verge says Max-plan access and compares them to OpenAI Dots and Claude Duet.

items.headline: AA scores Nanbeige4.3-33B at 20 on Intelligence Index v5
items.why: Apache 2.0 dense 33B model matching Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh). Weights have been on Hugging Face since late October.

items.headline: Tencent launches Hy4 (vision + computer use); weights in coming days
items.why: Another big Chinese open-weight promise. No Artificial Analysis or Epoch score yet.

items.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights still absent on Hugging Face on Nov 4
items.why: Moonshot promised by Nov 4. Newest moonshotai repo is still Kimi-K3 (2 Sep). Watch Beijing EOD.

items.headline: Moonshot posts Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights on Hugging Face on deadline day
items.why: 2.8T MoE / 104B active, 1M context; public ungated repo. AA Index v5 still 46 from the API-era score.

items.headline: Qualcomm Q4: non-GAAP revenue $10.4B; reiterates $5B FY27 data-center target
items.why: Handsets −26%; auto record $2B. Slides: Q1 DC $650M+, exit FY27 ~$7B annualized.

items.headline: Arm Q2 revenue $1.44B (+27%); data-center royalties double y/y
items.why: Licensing +50%. AGI CPU confidence raised to up to $2B across FY27–28; first deliveries Q4 FY27.

items.headline: OpenAI ships Images 2.6 with native GIFs and Flare/Sunburst API models
items.why: Claims 50% faster gen; SVG + markup edits. Product release, not a new frontier LLM.

items.headline: Meta acquires Conductor, a multi-agent coding workspace startup
items.why: Cloud shuts Nov 20; local app until early 2027; Meta says a new interface early 2027.

items.headline: Artificial Analysis scores Tencent Hy4 at 35 on Intelligence Index v5
items.why: First independent Hy4 read. Company still said weights in coming days as of Wed.

items.headline: Google publishes end-to-end framework for evaluating health AI
items.why: Accuracy, safety, usefulness via benchmarks, autoraters, and expert review.

items.headline: Qualcomm slides: Data Center Q1FY27 $650M+, exit FY27 ~$7B annualized
items.why: Amazon multi-gen silicon + optical; warrants up to $60B potential purchases over 10 years.

items.headline: AMD Q3: revenue $13.4B; data center a record $8.5B, up 97%
items.why: DC now 64% of sales. Q4 guide about $17B ±3%, non-GAAP GM about 55%. Instinct + EPYC led.

items.headline: AMD ships MI455X in volume; Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI run first Helios racks
items.why: Su on the call. Helios to ramp in Q4 as HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others ship systems.

items.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to any developer in iOS 27.3 beta
items.why: App Intents + skills. App Store submissions open in spring. Daily usage limits restated; paid access later.

items.headline: Apple Intelligence enters China developer beta with Qwen inside Siri
items.why: Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence too. No Siri AI in China. Public release expected in December.

items.headline: NYT: Anthropic aims to double compute to over 7 GW in 2027
items.why: About 3.5 GW by year-end. Sits behind the ~$895B commitments already on the S-1/A.

items.headline: Artificial Analysis moves speed headline to Time per Task; CritPt regrade
items.why: Methodology change only. Gemini 4 Carbon High still #1 on Index v5 at 59.

items.headline: Anthropic is expected to start pitching its IPO to investors the week of 9 November
items.why: Per Reuters' sources. Under SEC rules the S-1 must be public 15 days before that pitch starts, so it should land by late October.
